failure_policy: Keep first pinned source and raw outputs, root-cause any unexpected result before corrective admission; no fixture replay.

image_reference_shape.consistency: Both identities must match the canonical runtime record byte length and digest; matching source identities alone do not prove current filesystem bytes.
image_reference_shape.global: Actual source identity record for the fixed store references/<reference_key>.json.
image_reference_shape.record: Closed runtime reference record; workspace key and canonical selected C/image paths rederive.

implementation: Inactive pure Perl v2 preparation record encode/decode plus independent Python record/byte oracle; product preparation and older codecs remain unchanged.
independent_runtime_oracle: Compile only original canonical/key/pairs/validate definitions. After independently checking the fixed canonical source prefix, translate only its selected-source prefix to the old isolated case for the unchanged frozen structural oracle. No original oracle main or fixture is executed; the original canonical record byte digest is checked before any translation.

outcomes.failure: ok zero always requires executable null and non-success status with a bounded diagnostic. Preserve available compilation and source evidence; image_reference may be null until complete acquisition. image_admission and image_reference failures retain invocation_error.
outcomes.legacy: Selected Perl, private-native v1 and early unselected v1 failure stay on the original path; no v1 record is silently upgraded or normalized by this codec.
outcomes.success: Native selection, successful settled compilation, complete private and canonical source pairs with equal lengths/digests, complete matching references, canonical executable, success status and null failure_stage.

qualification: Pin vectors, implementation and Python oracle before execution. Use source-derived original compilation/preparation fields, inert canonical records with synthetic IDs, independent JSON/key/digest reconstruction, cross-version/field/type/path/order/reference/failed-executable controls, original saved v1 preservation and source-bound diagnostic-before-runtime ordering. Compare both valid bytes and rejected cases; never run compiler, native proxy, collector or old qualification mains.
remaining: Actual source/custody provenance, current inode/volume/permission checks, image content key rederivation from actual compiled bytes, native ancestry, ownership transport and activation remain outside this pure record codec. Preserve all historical failures.

selected_limits.meaning: Preparation envelope ceiling is a selected in-memory policy bound, not a measured reachable boundary; original compiler and runtime ceilings remain unchanged.

source_meanings.compilation_sources: Available private generated C and executable identity prefix in that order; success requires the complete pair.
source_meanings.identity: Closed path/device/inode/size_bytes/sha256 records; exact fixed paths, bounds and distinct file identities; source consistency is historical metadata, not a fresh byte observation.
source_meanings.sources: Available selected canonical C/executable pair in that order, or empty before selection. A complete image_reference must match it exactly.
